deviations_from_report: The complete suite and the eval harness were run (the audit ran a 243-test subset and relied on CI for evals). Both pass; the evals pass while still reporting the npm-test PROCEED miss.
The five tests the audit excluded pass on a full checkout; run_selected_tests.py still hard-codes their exclusion, so its 243 count is unchanged.
Python 3.11.15 here versus 3.13.5 in the audit; results are identical.
tools/audit/ is excluded from ruff so the scripts stay byte-identical to the checksummed bundle.

tests/test_audit_regressions.py was not created. WP00 step 3 converts cases into regressions as each repair package lands; adding 19 failing tests now would turn CI red, and expected-failure wrappers would make known defects look green.
